rule: Every evidence line is a canonical document line, never a capsule-local line.

capsule_source_format.mapping: The first content line after each marker maps exactly to that marker's start line; advance one canonical line per following content line through end.

validation.range_requirement: line_start and line_end must lie wholly within one assigned core_range or context_range
validation.path_requirement: document_path must equal the immutable assigned document_path
validation.quote_requirement: After whitespace normalization, the exact quote must occur within the canonical source lines line_start through line_end
validation.candidate_requirement: Every candidate finding must include at least one core evidence reference
validation.pre_submit_self_check: Validate every nested evidence reference and every exact_evidence_refs entry against the marker-derived canonical mapping. Do not submit if any quote is absent from its claimed canonical lines.
